verdict.rationale: Firestore/Realtime Database are built around live listeners; docs note data can be written, read, listened to, and queried even offline (firebase-docs-3), and community anecdotes confirm real-time sync (whiteboard app with synced client positions, real-time notifications added in hours) (firebase-comm-1, firebase-comm-14). Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the onSnapshot/.on() listener API and any independent benchmark of update latency.
